summary: Cover client cancellation in the existing owner PWA service-worker timeout regression test.

evidence.failure: The timeout test verified timer-driven fetch cancellation but did not verify that an incoming navigation abort signal also cancels the service-worker fetch.
validation: The existing test invokes the actual service-worker fetch handler with a controlled pending fetch.
The added case aborts the caller signal and verifies that the underlying request aborts and the cached shell fallback is returned.
The existing owner PWA reliability test passes.
evidence.rollback: Revert the added client-abort scenario and this test-only change record. No service-worker implementation, package, deployment, endpoint, firmware, or control state changed.
